Interface CatalinaCluster

All Superinterfaces:
Cluster, Contained
All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleTcpCluster
public interface CatalinaCluster extends Cluster
A CatalinaCluster interface allows to plug in and out the different cluster implementations
